lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Thanks for calling — this is AVA. What are you looking to come in for?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Do you do lip filler? I've got a wedding in three weeks and I want to look good.

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: We do — and three weeks is the perfect runway for filler to settle. Have you had filler with us before?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No, this would be my first time. Is there a consult, or—

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: There is — your first visit includes a complimentary consult, then treatment the same day if you're comfortable.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Okay. How much is the filler?

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Lip filler starts at six-fifty a syringe, and the consult itself is free. I've got Thursday at two P-M open.

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Thursday, two P-M — you're booked. Your confirmation and prep instructions are on their way by text.

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Skip the wine and any blood thinners the day before, Mia — see you Thursday.
